pages.quiz:
ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. Only one word repeated
   C. No full stops
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

2. When practising Guided Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Guided Writing.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Writing.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Guided Writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Writing.

3. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.

4. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.

5. When practising Language Activities at home, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Language Activities at home.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Language Activities at home.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Language Activities at home.

6. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. happiness
   B. run
   C. quickly
   D. blue

7. When practising Spelling, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Spelling.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Spelling.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Spelling.

8. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the Library
   B. where is the library
   C. Where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

9. When practising Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening.

10. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only an action
   B. Only a joining word
   C. Only a describing word
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

11. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. went
   B. going
   C. goes
   D. goed

12. When practising Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Punctuation.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Punctuation.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Punctuation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Word Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — One main idea with supporting sentences

2. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Writing.

3. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.

4. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.

5. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.

6. B — run

7. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.

8. D — Where is the library?

9. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.

10. D — A person, place, thing, or idea

11. A — went

12. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Guided Writing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Attentive Listening; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Word Reading; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Connected text and fluency; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
